kind: profile-only source-preparation contract; not live execution authorization
rootAdmission: New exact source/spec/StageA-PE/head packet and specific root admission required; consumed historical B is not reusable

identity.account: one newly generated nonce/SAM and independently queried ownedSID, initially disabled and Users-only

cwd: fresh owned Controller parent outside Git; input and Controller roots are siblings
stdio: closed stdin; bounded separate stdout/stderr in owned stage directory

environment.base: clear inherited child environment; reconstruct explicit allowlist only
environment.omitted: all unlisted variables, credentials, Actions/GitHub tokens, provider/config overrides and COMPLUS overrides; no inherited target profile environment

observability.readOnly: bounded OS/CLR/userenv/export/token/privilege/service metadata and input lengths/hashes; own SID ProfileList and owned candidate profile metadata only
observability.forbidden: passwords, full environment/profile contents, global audit, service mutation or retries

cleanup.required: exact owned SID/SAM/fullmarker/runner and established path/hive/lease/handle identities
cleanup.partialFailure: arm uncertainty before API; unproven partial profile must remain failed/unknown, never blind profile/registry/account deletion or globally-cleaned claim
cleanup.accountDisable: only exactly bound own account; no password change; unknown remains unknown
cleanup.no: Debug privilege, ancestor/global ACL changes, unknown process kills, profile unload without original lease, retry or manual repair

historicalFacts: all five remain not_run, released product PE not executed, compatibility disabled, old22 fatal; profile-only is not B/F1 proof
